expectations.text: Classifies the material as factual (事实记忆型)
expectations.evidence: All four groups are labelled factual: "[核心 · 事实记忆] 药代基本参数…", "[核心 · 事实记忆] 受体与药效…", "[核心 · 事实记忆，含公式] 给药方案…", "[重要 · 事实记忆] 反复用药及其他…".

expectations.text: Plans retrieval practice with spaced repetition, and chunking or a mnemonic aid (e.g. grouping pairs like agonist/antagonist/partial agonist, or potency vs efficacy)
expectations.evidence: "主力是闭卷回忆（给术语说定义，也会反过来给定义说术语）加间隔复习"; the 20 terms are chunked into 4 groups (受体与药效 groups 激动剂/拮抗剂/部分激动剂/效能/效价强度); "请你自己造记忆钩子"; contrast items for "效能和效价强度、零级和一级、耐受性和快速耐受"; dated schedule 10-31 / 11-01 / 11-02.

expectations.text: Does not use a Feynman explanation task or everyday analogies for the definitions
expectations.evidence: No Feynman task and no analogies anywhere; the reply explicitly says "术语表没有'为什么'可推".

expectations.text: Uses flashcard-style (term -> definition or reverse) or cloze questions, presented as plain text
expectations.evidence: Term -> definition prompts in plain text: "每个用一句话说出意思：1. 半衰期 2. 生物利用度 …"; reverse direction is planned ("也会反过来给定义说术语").

expectations.text: Asks only one card / item at a time and hides its answer
expectations.evidence: Answers are hidden, but the reply asks five cards at once (半衰期、生物利用度、首过效应、表观分布容积、清除率) as a batch diagnostic, plus two setup questions a) and b) in the same message. That is not one card at a time.

expectations.text: Asks for confidence along with the answer
expectations.evidence: Missing: the reply never asks for confidence (no 1-3 rating or 把握度) for the five-term prompt or for later cards.

notes: No factual errors: 20 terms, grouped 5+6+5+4 = 20, which matches the glossary, and 2026-10-31 is a Saturday, 2026-11-02 a Monday. The reply handles the ambiguous '下周一' well: it states the assumption (11-02) and asks the user to confirm. Planning is strong (no terms dropped, confusable pairs flagged, a JSON progress note, and it admits it can't remember across chats). Main problems: the message is overloaded, with an outline, a schedule, two logistics questions, and a 5-item batch diagnostic all in one turn, and it never asks for confidence.
